name: portfolio_policy-hold-report
notes: ADR-0279 amendment 2026-10-28: the answer to 'what is it worth to hold this' as one markdown page. An earlier decision run's rows (published back through onboarding, one stream per run file) -> the few numbers per holding and for the portfolio -> report/<run>.md. weekly.sh runs the whole sequence for a snapshot day. The decision run name is a value of THIS document: reporting a different run is a different report.

decisions.notes: Role 'data': the decisions/<run>.jsonl the decision run wrote, acquired through localtables (layout file: the stream is the file stem = the run name), exactly as run-decision-outcomes.json reads it. The decision run's summary/<run>.jsonl is not read: its rows carry no instant, and localtables needs an effective_field on every row, so the summary is recomputed below from the decided rows, which carry as_of.

summary.notes: Restates run-hold-vs-redeploy.json summary's params (tests/test_hold_report.py pins them equal, key_fields aside), so every number matches the decision run's own summary. key_fields adds as_of: a key field rides onto each summary row, which is how the verdict page reads the decisions' own day for its title. betas and volatilities are not wired here: the decision rows carry neither, so the Beta and Vol columns read an em dash. Wiring the verdict node into the decision document itself (once the risk and lots lanes merge) gives them back.

params.source: hold verdict per account x symbol, with the portfolio block
params.title: What holding is worth

verdict.notes: Role 'report': one markdown page per run in ./report under the invoking cwd (gitignored). Holdings sorted by opportunity cost a year, highest first: above zero the after-tax alternative beats holding. The title day is the as_of the decisions carry (several refuse), not the run's --asof. The total's label states the universe (the decision document's snapshot keeps equity longs; tests/test_configs.py pins the words to its clauses). The portfolio block is the summary's metrics, wired, never recomputed.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Placement is not identity.
